name: imessage
description: Reads Messages (iMessage and SMS) on a Mac for who is waiting on a reply, catching up on a thread, finding what was said and what you promised. Read-only. Reads message text by default so it can tell a question from a thank-you; profile `redacted` hides the text.

waiting-on-me.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me skill to find who is waiting on a reply from me in Messages.

waiting-on-them.prompt: Use the waiting-on-them skill to find who I am waiting on a reply from in Messages.

action-now.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me and action-now-or-soon skills to answer action-now: what I need to act on today in Messages.

action-soon.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me and action-now-or-soon skills to answer action-soon: what I need to act on soon in Messages.

catch-up.prompt: Catch me up on one conversation in Messages: summarize it, who said what, what is open and what is next. Take the contact or group from the caller; if none is named, ask for one. Do not quote the whole thread.

commitments.prompt: Find the promises I made in Messages (things I said I would do, send or decide), with who I promised, the date and whether I appear to have done it. Take the period from the caller; default to the last 14 days.

find.prompt: Find what the caller asks for in Messages (something someone said, a number, an address, a plan) and name the conversation and date. Take the search from the caller; if none is given, ask for one.
